blocks.text: Testing software ko jaanchne (evaluate karne) ka process hai ta ke yaqeeni ho ke woh requirements poori karta hai aur tawaqqo ke mutabiq kaam karta hai. Testing ka process aam taur par ek darja-bandi (hierarchy) par chalta hai: chhote hisson se shuru ho kar aahista aahista poore system tak, aur aakhir mein user ki manzoori (user acceptance) tak. Is hierarchy ki main qismein neeche di gayi hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Tarteeb yaad rakhein: Unit Testing, phir Integration Testing, phir System Testing, phir Acceptance Testing.

blocks.prompt: Testing ke chaar levels kis tarteeb mein hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Unit, phir integration, phir system, phir acceptance testing: sab se chhote hisson se poore system tak, aur aakhir mein users ki manzoori.

items: Testing: requirements ke mutabiq software jaanchna; hierarchy: unit, integration, system, acceptance.
